profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the marketing and advertising industry. Skilled in SQL, PHP, C++, Docker, and Mercurial. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from San Francisco State University.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
·    Analyze and understand  business requirement/User Stories
·    Design application UI flow & actively participate and contribute to overall application design
·    Develop UI application with Angular ,Type Script, HTML,  CSS, and Node.js
.    Use RxJS/Observables/Http Client to access Rest  endpoints


For Regalix TV ( regalix.tv ), I built the frontend from the ground up. Made using the following technologies HTML, TypeScript, Javascript, RxJs,  CSS/SCSS, BootStrap, Angular 2+.




Became Twilio certified, worked on Twilio projects for clients, such as Flex contact center implementation.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Worked as frontend web developer, used technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, and PHP to develop the Shopify Plugin; Feedo.
